title: Matrix Character Under Unflattening
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $x$ be a vector of length $n^2$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The matrix character of $A$ evaluated at the matrix obtained by unflattening $x$ equals the $\mathbb{F}_2$ dot product of the flattening of $A$ with $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a vector of length $n^2$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$
